text:
maria: heads-up — local sampleapp rerank is throwing a TypeError only when using the Node SDK (python works)
maria: stack in node logs:
```
TypeError: Cannot read property 'length' of undefined
    at rankBatch (/workspace/sampleapp/src/rerank.js:62:18)
    at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:95:5)
```
jon: can you paste the raw embeddings responses from node vs python for the same batched inputs?
maria: python (ok):
```
{"id":"vec-1","embedding":[0.00012,-0.213,0.0034,... /* 1536 floats */],"model":"open-embed-1536"}
```
maria: node (problem):
```
{"id":"vec-1","embeds":["0.00012,-0.213,0.0034,...","0.00011,0.198,..."],"model":"open-embed-1536"}
```
sam: looks like two separate parity problems: field name is `embeds` in node vs `embedding` in python, and node is returning CSV string(s) for batched responses instead of numeric arrays
maria: confirmed — single-input calls in node return `embedding` numeric array fine. only when input is an array (>1) we get the CSV strings under `embeds`
lee: that smells like the batching helper serializing arrays for transport and not rehydrating correctly on the response path. also saw a flaky auth-retry bug that concatenated chunks once — might be related
maria: repro:
```js
// node repro
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'open-embed-1536', input: ['apple','banana'] })
// observed: result[0].embeds -> ["0.00012,-0.213,...","0.00011,0.198,..."]
```
jon: thanks. sam — can you triage batching helper + retry interaction? prioritize parity with python for the sampleapp onboarding flow
sam: on it. quick app-side workaround for teams blocked: normalize shape after call — if response.embeds present then do `const norm = response.embeds.map(s => s.split(',').map(Number)).map(e => ({ embedding: e }))` and pass that into rerank until we ship an SDK fix
maria: workaround works locally, pushed a tiny fix in sampleapp and opened PR redwood/devex#812 with notes for onboarding guide
ci-bot: CI: embed-shape-integration.test.ts failed — expected `embedding: number[]` but got `embeds: string[]` in node-sdk samples
lee: i'll add a unit/regression test in node-sdk and plan a patch release. also adding an integration check in sampleapp CI that compares node vs python response shapes for every embedding-related test
maria: thanks — i'll update the onboarding troubleshooting doc with the workaround and a short note about the PR. tagging @sam to follow the auth-retry angle too
maria: :pray:
